messages.en: I thought that was a dog at first. Turns out it was a wolf!
Yeah, I've seen that video. Its fur is gorgeous!
Do you eat at that place often? I'd like to try it.
Yeah, I've tried lots of dishes there. Their chicken in spicy tomato sauce is delicious!

senses.en_definition: Earnest or sincere; not joking or treating something lightly.
Having significant or harmful consequences and requiring careful attention.
Of an illness or injury: severe or dangerous.

messages.en: Are you really planning to carry on with your studies next year, or are you just saying that?
I'm serious! I've already checked the entry requirements. I just haven't decided which university to apply to yet.
That was so much fun! I really want to go again!
Right? I've already asked Hana to come along next week.
